meta.title: DoA Threshold Currency (approval.doa.currency) = SGD
gaps: Set tenant setting approval.doa.currency to SGD
Use Modular Approval Setup to attach approvals to entities
Observe that Delegation of Authority spend thresholds use SGD and differ from the default INR
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Set tenant setting approval.doa.currency to SGD; Use Modular Approval Setup to attach approvals to entities; Observe that Delegation of Authority spend thresholds use SGD and differ from the default INR

args.need: as a Tenant Admin, set approval.doa.currency to SGD, use Modular Approval Setup to make approvals attachable to entities, and verify in the Delegation of Authority matrix that all spend threshold currency units are SGD rather than INR

steps.note: The catalog cannot access tenant configuration, Modular Approval Setup, or the Delegation of Authority threshold matrix.
After the tester completes the missing flow, check for visible evidence of the selected SGD currency; this does not by itself verify the full threshold behavior.
